description: Get Sitecore users, by exact identity or by wildcard filter. Supply exactly one of identity or filter.

filter.description: Wildcard pattern, e.g. 'sitecore\*'. Supply this or identity.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

identity.description: Exact account name, e.g. 'sitecore\admin'. Supply this or filter.

name: security-get-user
